sloka: रावणिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्तान्निरीक्ष्य निशाचरान्।हृष्टा भवन्तो युद्ध्यन्तु वानराणां जिघांसया ।। ६.७३.२८ ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇistu tataḥ kruddhastānnirīkṣya niśācarān।hṛṣṭā bhavanto yuddhyantu vānarāṇāṁ jighāṁsayā ।। 6.73.28 ।।

translations.english: While the missile was being invoked and fire sacrifice was done, all planets, moon, Sun, and Stars in the sky shook in fear.
